goal: Keep the AstrBot system entries overlay usable as the number of operational links grows by showing a compact top rail and a categorized dynamic entry directory.

acceptance_criteria.description: The fixed dashboard overlay renders only a limited high-priority shortcut rail plus compact buttons for the full entry directory and Watch-Dog controls.
The full entry directory supports category metadata, grouped cards, search text, and live status summaries without hardcoding every visible link into the top rail.
Pinned dashboard entries and backend system entries carry category and priority metadata so sorting and grouping remain stable when status payloads are refreshed.

ui_policy.watchdog_controls: available through the same overlay as a separate panel view
